svg.text: Supply in: Boiler B6 30 mA RCBO
mains-rated logic cable, own gland → control-room ESP32 GPIO14/18/15/16
Same control logic as stage 2. New: 3095Y 5-core to the HW relays, Wago 221 at four tapped joints, opto board in its own enclosure, sleeving and caps.
W1 Wago: cyl R stat out
W2 Wago: cyl L stat out
Positions 1, 2, 3 and the SL joint move to Wago 221 (W1, W2, W3, W7) because each gains an opto tap; bars and positions 4-6 stay on choc blocks (twin ferrules for pairs).
No blue carries a switched live on the new HW relay cables (black = A, grey = B). Remaining misused colours are sleeved at both ends.
